type Choice = { kind: "a"; a: number } | { kind: "b"; b: string };
function direct(value: Choice) {
  const kind = value.kind;
  if (kind === "a") return value.a;
  return value.b;
}
function indexed<T extends Choice>(value: T) {
  const kind = (value["kind"]);
  return kind === "a" ? value.a : value.b;
}
function selected(value: { item: Choice }) {
  const kind = value.item.kind;
  switch (kind) {
    case "a": return value.item.a;
    case "b": return value.item.b;
  }
}
console.log(direct({ kind: "a", a: 1 }), direct({ kind: "b", b: "b" }));
console.log(indexed({ kind: "a", a: 2 }), selected({ item: { kind: "b", b: "done" } }));
